description: Source code implementing Bluetooth A2DP (Advanced Audio Distribution Profile) functionalities, including connection management, registration, and initialization.

methods.name: a2d_reset
methods.description: Resets the a2dp connection structure to default state.

methods.name: get_new_connection
methods.description: Allocates and returns a new a2dp connection structure for a given Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: a2dp_accept
methods.description: Handles incoming AVDTP connection requests and assigns a new session.

methods.name: bt_a2dp_init
methods.description: Initializes the A2DP profile by registering event handlers.

methods.name: bt_a2dp_connect
methods.description: Establishes an A2DP connection for a given Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: bt_a2dp_register_endpoint
methods.description: Registers an A2DP endpoint with specified media type and role.
